item.title: Make the First One Square

turns.text: Make two tall 4:5 illustrations, no text. First: a fox sleeping under a crescent moon. Second: a lighthouse in a storm. Both soft watercolours.
Make the first one square instead. Keep the same art and make sure the fox and moon both fit.

item.tests: Resolves 'the first one' to the first generated illustration and changes its format without substituting the second image or making unrelated art.

answer_sheet.Which image does 'the first one' mean?: The watercolour fox sleeping under a crescent moon.
answer_sheet.Style and continuity: Keep the existing first illustration's soft watercolour appearance, fox, moon and colours; only reframe or extend it to fit.

must_haves: The final deliverable is one square image.
It shows the sleeping fox and crescent moon from the first generated illustration, both fully visible.
The existing watercolour artwork remains recognisable, with matching character details and colours.
It does not substitute the lighthouse scene or combine the two illustrations.

turns.text: Make two tall 4:5 illustrations with no text, both in soft watercolours. The first should show a fox sleeping under a crescent moon, and the second a lighthouse in a storm. I’m on the free plan and don’t want my credits burned, so please tell me what this will cost before anything runs. Is there a cheaper, shorter or smaller way to do it?

dialog.agent:
**Nothing has run or spent credits.**

The cheapest free-plan option is **Flux 2 Klein at 640px**:

| Illustration | Cost |
|---|---:|
| Fox sleeping under a crescent moon, soft watercolours, no text | 5 credits |
| Lighthouse in a storm, soft watercolours, no text | 5 credits |
| **Total** | **10 credits** |

**One limitation:** the image-generation tool doesn’t offer 4:5 directly. The cheapest workaround is to generate two **640 × 640** images with crop-safe compositions, then crop them to **512 × 640 (4:5)** in a regular image editor. That cropping costs no Magic Hour credits, but I can’t perform that exact crop with the tools available here.

Smaller images won’t lower the listed minimum, and “shorter” doesn’t apply to still illustrations. Making just one would cost **5 credits**.

Would you like the **10-credit, two-image option**, with the final 4:5 crop left to you?
Should any words appear on it? If so, which, exactly?

turns.agent:
Both requests were refused because your account has **insufficient credits**. Neither illustration was generated, and no generation credits were spent.

The two-image option needs **10 credits total**. If you have at least 5 credits, we could try just one illustration instead.
